claim_one_line: THE O3 GATE APPLIED RETROACTIVELY -- B922's priority sentence corrected. Review 40 found the asymmetry: B940's prereg invented the O3 gate (no priority word until the sweep reaches MathSciNet/zbMATH grade) and honoured it, but B922 had already banked 'the first 25-digit Maass eigenvalue on any hyperbolic 3-manifold' on a sweep of unrecorded depth -- and a gate that binds only future arcs is not a standard. The same adversarial panel was run against the older claim. VERDICT: PRIOR ART FOUND -- PARTIAL. (1) THE PRECEDENT NUMBER IS REFUTED: the repo asserted '~10 digits'; the true published figure is 13 DECIMAL PLACES (r = 6.6221193402528, the Picard orbifold PSL(2,Z[i]) ground state, Aurich-Steiner-Then arXiv:gr-qc/0404020 section 8 -- the '~10' came from their TABLES, which print 8). B922's 25 places lead by 12, not 15. (2) Maass eigenvalues on hyperbolic 3-manifolds have been computed abundantly (an eight-item literature 1991-2025), and Inoue computed them on genuine CLOSED hyperbolic 3-manifolds, so 'cusp form' was doing real work and was absent. (3) THE PULLBACK CAVEAT, RESOLVED BY A FACT THIS SEAT COMPUTED RATHER THAN ACCEPTED: since Gamma_41 is contained in PSL(2,O_3) at index 12, every published PARENT eigenvalue already is an m004 eigenvalue by pullback, and published parent data exists (r ~ 24.5033, which this repo already banks as a control without having registered that it defeats 'm004 has never been computed'). Verified in-sandbox from Humbert's volume formula and the Weyl law alone: zeta_K(2) = 1.28519095548415, vol(parent) = 0.169156934401609, vol(m004) = 2.02988321281931, RATIO = 12.0 EXACTLY (the index, reproduced independently); W_parent(7.072004187) = 1.0103372, REPRODUCING B791's own W = 1.010 from scratch and confirming 7.072 is the parent's GROUND STATE; and the row that matters, W_parent(4.9000853730...) = 0.33608548, WELL UNDER ONE -- so r = 4.90008... lies BELOW the parent's spectrum and cannot be a pullback. HONEST LIMIT: the Weyl law is a leading-order SCREEN, not a theorem-grade exclusion, and the mesh scan that localized the parent ground state ran over [6.4, 7.35] and does not itself exclude a parent eigenvalue below 6.4 -- the non-inheritance qualifier is SCREENED AND CONSISTENT, NOT PROVEN. (4) WE DECLINE THE AVAILABLE ESCAPE: all the high-precision prior art is on ORBIFOLDS, so reading 'hyperbolic 3-MANIFOLD' strictly would technically save the original sentence -- that is exactly the necessary-read-as-sufficient move B525 was written against, and a claim that survives only by a word its author did not intend is not a claim that survived. THE CORRECTION AS BANKED replaces the priority sentence with a comparative statement carrying NO PRIORITY WORD AT ALL (MathSciNet is still behind an auth wall, so the O3 standard remains HALF MET for this arc as for B940): the second Maass CUSP FORM eigenvalue of the figure-eight knot complement to 25 decimal places, improving the published precedent from 13, and NOT INHERITED from the parent Bianchi group. The two load-bearing qualifiers -- 'cusp form' and 'not inherited' -- are the analogues of the Dirac sweep's 'nonzero' and 'cusped'. Carried gaps: Grunewald-Huntebrinker Table 3 remains unreachable, CONFIRMING open lead B921-17 is still open and leaving B791's secondary-reported 51.014 UNVERIFIED -- nothing in this correction depends on it. Control PASSED (the sweep finds the known H^2 work), and the 'H^2 reaches 1000 digits' side-claim is corroborated verbatim (1000 computed, 100 certified). METHOD NOTE: citation-graph closure was decisive and keyword search worthless -- the second sweep in two days where enumerating the citing set was the move that worked. B922's MATHEMATICS IS UNTOUCHED; what changed is the sentence wrapped around it.
